{{Quote|The establishment assumes no responsibility for any beast-yeasts that may escape from the kitchen during food preparation.|Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Beast-yeast''' was an ingredient used at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was in some way capable of independent movement and the [[Restaurant/Legends|diner's]] menu included a warning to all customers stating the it assumed no responsibility for any beast-yeasts that escaped the kitchen during food preparation.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beast-yeast was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
